title: wt checkout --json
description: What a `wt checkout` run did, side effect by side effect. Printed by `wt checkout --json` as the only thing on stdout, also when a handled SIGINT or SIGTERM ends the run. Schema 1: fields may be added and enumerations may gain values; nothing is renamed or removed. See docs/json.md.

schema.description: The major version: a new one only for a change that breaks readers.

schemaVersion.description: The full semantic version of this schema that the output follows: minor for an added field or enumeration value, patch for wording.

outcome.description: created: the worktree made, every step done or skipped. createdWithProblems: the worktree made, and a step failed or was not run, or it is not on expectedCommit. refused: nothing made, see problems. failed: git worktree add failed and left no worktree. interrupted: a signal ended the run.

error.description: Why the run was refused or stopped before creating anything.

problems.description: Why it was refused, or what is wrong with the worktree made that no step names.

base.description: For wt new: what the branch was cut from. Null for wt checkout.

expectedCommit.description: The commit the plan pinned: the base's for wt new, the branch's for wt checkout — for source remote, the remote-tracking ref's.

commit.description: The new worktree's HEAD, read after it was created; null when none was.

source.description: Since 1.1.0. Where the branch comes from: local, a local branch of that exact name, checked out as it is; remote, a remote-tracking ref as last fetched (no fetch is made), from which the local branch was created, tracking it. Null when neither has it.

remote.description: Since 1.1.0. For source remote: the remote. Null otherwise.

remoteRef.description: Since 1.1.0. For source remote: its remote-tracking ref, refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch>, which becomes the branch's upstream. Null otherwise.

upstream.description: Since 1.1.0. The branch's upstream ref, read back after the run (refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch>); null when it has none or there is no branch.

steps.description: Every side effect, in the order they happen: worktree, branch, config, provision, submodules, build, superset.

code.description: The plan's problems, and planChanged (--expect no longer holds, or a local branch of that name appeared before wt could create it from the remote; it is never overwritten), headMoved (the worktree is not on expectedCommit).

result.description: worktree: created (with a reason when git failed after making it), failed. branch: created (wt new, and wt checkout from a remote, its reason tracking <remote>/<branch>), untouched (wt checkout of a local branch). config, provision, submodules, build: done, skipped, failed. superset: registered, skipped, failed. Any step: notRun, interrupted.

commit.description: worktree: its HEAD. branch: its tip.

reason.description: Why, for skipped, failed and interrupted; a note otherwise.
